raw_posts.name: Letter Visitors
raw_posts.tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
raw_posts.description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

raw_posts.name: Motionflare
raw_posts.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
raw_posts.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

raw_posts.name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
raw_posts.tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
raw_posts.description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

raw_posts.name: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
raw_posts.description: What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.

raw_posts.name: Modem
raw_posts.tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
raw_posts.description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

raw_posts.name: Polylane Swarms
raw_posts.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
raw_posts.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

raw_posts.name: Inkling 2 Mini
raw_posts.tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
raw_posts.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

raw_posts.name: Chat with Work
raw_posts.tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
raw_posts.description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

raw_posts.name: Hydrilla
raw_posts.description: Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.

raw_posts.name: Journalistic Tech
raw_posts.tagline: Async interviews that get you published on HackerNoon
raw_posts.description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.
